meta.title: About us
meta.description: Aura Academy was founded by Amira Bechini, CEO of Amira Beauty Suite: over 8 years in the beauty industry and more than 150 students trained. Professional training in permanent makeup and lash and brow lamination throughout Italy.

about.titleA: We teach from inside the profession,
about.lede: Amira Bechini teaches only what she practises: every technique in these courses is one she performs daily in her own treatment room. In class you learn by doing, with your hand corrected as you work.

story.title: From the treatment room to the classroom
story.role: Founder of Aura Academy · CEO of Amira Beauty Suite
story.imageAlt: Amira Bechini in the studio, in a black blazer, arms folded, against a pale ground.
story.p1: I run Amira Beauty Suite, an institute specialised in advanced aesthetic treatments, and founded Aura Academy to teach what I practise: permanent makeup and lash and brow lamination.
story.p2: In more than eight years I have trained over 150 students and built a way of teaching that is my own: technique, practice, and business sense.
story.p3: I have never stopped studying: international masterclasses, the latest PMU techniques. My own institute taught me the rest, not just the technique, but what clients and the market need.
story.p4: Aura Academy is the school I wanted when I started: personalised guidance, practical education, continuous support, and a career that lasts. Today we train across Italy.

different.title: Built on the work, not on the theory
different.sub: Three deliberate choices sit behind every course we run.

experience.title: Real industry experience
experience.body: Aura Academy grew out of the daily work of a functioning beauty institute. What you learn here has already been proven in the treatment room.

small.title: Small classes, by design
small.body: Places are intentionally limited. A small group is what makes individual attention possible, rather than something we promise and cannot give.

support.title: Before, during and after
support.body: Continuous mentoring, practical feedback, correction of your work, and professional guidance once the course has ended.

beyond.title: A technique alone is not a career.
beyond.sub: A PMU artist has to master more than the treatment. Alongside the technique, we teach the eight things that turn a skill into a business.

mission.quote: The certificate is not the point. The career is.
mission.body: At Aura Academy we do not teach treatments alone. We train professionals: technique, business sense, and help that continues after the course.

vision.title: An international reference for PMU education
vision.body: We want Aura Academy to grow in Italy and abroad, through a network of certified trainers and a community of professionals who work to the same rigour.
vision.closing: Modern, practical, market-oriented education, and more women able to build an independent future.

powder.title: A brow built in shade, not in strokes.
powder.intro: Powder brows is a permanent makeup technique for the eyebrow. Pigment is applied with a machine in fine dots, so the brow reads as a soft, shaded finish rather than as individual hair strokes.

points.technique: Where microblading draws individual hairs with a blade, powder brows is shaded with the machine.
points.finish: A soft shaded brow built with the machine, from a light veil to a defined finish.
points.levels: Taught at base and advanced level, in Italian, in groups of 3-4 students.

meta.title: Privacy
meta.description: How Aura Academy di Amira Bechini handles the details sent through the contact form: controller, purpose, retention and your rights.

privacy.title: How we handle your details
privacy.lede: This site collects personal details only when you write through the contact form. Nothing is sold or passed on to third parties.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.body: Aura Academy di Amira Bechini, Lungomare Rodi 20, 64021 Giulianova (TE), Italy. VAT 02228390676, REA TE-221017. Any request about personal data can be sent to the certified address at the foot of this page.

data.title: What is collected
data.body: Only what you type into the form: your name, email address, the course you are asking about and the text of your message. The site asks for nothing else and infers nothing.

purpose.title: Why
purpose.body: To answer you and send dates, duration and a quote for the course you are interested in. Your details are not used for marketing.

basis.title: Legal basis
basis.body: Steps taken at your request before entering into a contract, under Article 6(1)(b) of Regulation (EU) 2016/679.

recipients.title: Who sees it
recipients.body: The site's hosting provider and the mail service that delivers your message to the academy's inbox, both acting as processors. Nobody else has access.

retention.title: How long
retention.body: Messages are kept for as long as it takes to deal with your enquiry and any follow-up, then deleted.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: The site sets one technical cookie, which remembers the language you chose. There are no analytics, profiling or advertising cookies, and no third-party tracking.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You may ask at any time for access to your data, for it to be corrected or erased, for processing to be restricted, for portability, and to object. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Italian data protection authority.

contact.title: Getting in touch
contact.body: To exercise your rights, write to the academy's certified address:

stroke.title: One hair at a time.
stroke.body: Microblading is drawn stroke by stroke, in the direction the hair actually grows. Depth, angle and spacing decide whether the result stays natural as it fades.
